row: Let's be S.M.A.R.T. Animal Welfare Organization

🐾 Cat rescue in Greece | Stray & abandoned cats rescued, rehabilitated & rehomed | Let's Be S.M.A.R.T. From street kittens to forgotten seniors, from disabled cats to the ones nobody wanted — every cat gets the care they deserve.

🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell to follow more rescues.

We proudly uphold the S.M.A.R.T. Code, pledging to:
⭐ Show kindness to all animals
⭐ Make a difference for animals in distress
⭐ Advocate against abuse of any kind
⭐ Raise awareness about animals' importance
⭐ Treat animals with understanding and respect
By working together, we can ensure a brighter future for all living beings.

Every small donation helps:
PayPal: donations@letsbesmart.org
Bank Transfer: https://www.letsbesmart-greece.org/donations
Ongoing Emergency Vet Bill Fundraiser: https://justgiving.com/fundraising/let-s-be-smart
PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/LetsBeSmartRescue
